Treat this as a 2026 decline, not a do-not-contact request. Current reply signature confirms Jean Flynn Ray, Event Planner, Live Joi Communications LLC, www.livejoicom.com, 720-401-3417, replying from jeanfray@gmail.com. Earlier outreach used jray@ci.sheridan.co.us; preserve that as historical contact data but use Jean's current reply address for future communication unless a newer official contact is verified. Do not push pay-for-play again in this thread because the Aug. 27 email already explained the no-upfront/pay-for-play option before Jean declined.
